```python
shell_check = await run_command("curl -L --max-time 15 -s 'https://www.google.com/search?q=%22Can+Hiccup+Supply+Enough+Fish%22' | head -c 5000")

The direct retrieval check did not expose a usable paper record, so I’m querying broader bibliographic wording one last time.

broad_lookup = await web_search("dragon diet fish Hiccup Leicester Physics Special Topics", max_results=20)

I’m checking a bibliographic API for the exact title, which may expose the paper even when general web search does not.
```python
bib_check = await run_command("curl -L --max-time 15 -sG 'https://api.openalex.org/works' --data-urlencode 'search=Can Hiccup Supply Enough Fish to Maintain a Dragons Diet' | head -c 8000")
print(bib_check)
```
